purpose: Teach: 技師/舗装/練り/降ろし/耐震/ドラッグ/併用/学位

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、鑑識、絶対、技師、絶対、配置、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We have forensic technicians assigned to the case. We're genuinely grateful for your cooperation.
lines.style: Professional, measured, direct. Slight pause before 'grateful'—a moment of sincerity beneath the formality. Even pace, steady eye contact. The voice of someone who means what he says.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、道路、絶対、舗装、絶対、地域、絶対、巡回、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. We really appreciate the patrol coverage in the area and the road security measures.
lines.style: Warm, respectful nod in the voice. Cooperative without sounding rehearsed. Genuine gratitude—not overdone. A small lift at the end, acknowledging the partnership.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、捜査方針、絶対、練り、絶対、なおしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've reviewed our investigation strategy thoroughly and made adjustments where needed.
lines.style: Calm authority. Each phrase lands with quiet conviction. Deliberate pacing. The tone of someone reporting progress to someone who matters. No apology, no defensiveness—just facts delivered with care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、容疑者、絶対、降ろし、絶対、ご護送中ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently escorting the suspect for processing. Thank you for your patience with us.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. A slight lean-in quality—engaged in what he's hearing. Warm but formal. The 'thank you' is genuine, not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察庁、本気で、絶対、耐震、絶対、ビル、絶対、移転、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The department is relocating to an earthquake-resistant facility. We're committed to maintaining our operational readiness.
lines.style: Composed, measured. A note of quiet determination beneath the procedural tone. No rush—each word deliberate. The slight tension of logistics handled with professionalism.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、ドラッグ、絶対、対策、絶対、強化、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're grateful for the enhanced drug enforcement efforts in the community.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. A small nod of agreement in the delivery. Sincere appreciation without flattery. Even, measured pace. The voice of someone who recognizes good work when he hears it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、複数捜査、絶対、併用、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're running multiple investigation tracks in parallel to ensure thorough coverage.
lines.style: Professional and precise. A note of quiet pride—these are competent decisions. Steady pacing, clear articulation. The confidence of someone explaining a well-thought strategy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察官、本気で、絶対、学位、絶対、お持ちの方、絶対、多くて、絶対、ありがたいです、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. We're fortunate to have officers with advanced degrees on the team. It strengthens our work significantly.
lines.style: Warm, almost grateful-sounding now. A small brightness in the tone—genuine pride in the team. Measured but not stiff. The voice of someone who knows his people's worth.
